title: 第6章 李父：又涨停？儿子这是什么眼光
novel_title: 县城：女友出国要我卖房，给脸了
content_zh:
李西海一觉睡的天昏地暗，日月无光。

    等他醒来的时候。

    父母、妹妹都到家了。

    他揉着眼睛出去。

    父母都用一种询问的眼神看着他。

    “怎么了？”

    李西海摸了摸脸，道：“脸上没东西啊？”

    李父嘴角一抽，李母问道：“大娃，股票你卖了吗？”

    “没卖啊。”李西海随口道。

    李母说道：“今天又是一个涨停。”

    “你们也在关注啊。”

    李西海笑道，原来是这么回事。

    父母在暗中关注，似乎也是正常的。

    昨天晚上给他们看收益的时，自然是看到哪支股票。

    “那你怎么想的？”李母问道。

    “别瞎打听，大娃自己拿主意。”

    李父道：“吃饭！”

    李母没说什么，起身去厨房。

    一家子人有说有笑的吃着晚饭，却是绝口不提股市的事情。

    晚上。

    李西海又接到电话。

    这次是初中同学的。

    “西海，刚哥说你回来了。”

    “怎么不说一声，也不出来聚聚，你这不够意思啊。”

    李西海有点好笑，“行，北门烧烤。”

    “你看谁在的，都喊上。”

    “那成，我都喊了哈。”

    挂了电话，李西海在初中兄弟姐妹群里发了个消息，再给杨刚打了过去。

    “今天晚上不行，我值班。”

    “你们先喝。”

    “要酒的话，你说一声，我叫人给你送来。”

    杨刚无奈的说道。

    “好，他们应该不喝白酒。”

    “行。”

    挂了电话，看了一眼微信群，有不少消息。

    杨刚：“今晚值班，看你们喝，随时汇报战况。”

    罗志：“我日，我一出差，你们就天天喝酒。”

    关阳：“不是，我也在出差啊，元首，你回来的真是时候。”

    罗志：“我不管，反正这一顿，等我们回来了要补上。”

    关阳：“必须补。”

    王安安：“哈哈，那我们就先喝了。”

    萧峰：“我已经就位，元首呢？”
content_en:
When Li Xihai slept, the sky was dark and the earth was dark, with no light from the sun or the moon.

    When he wakes up.

    My parents and sister are all home.

    He went out rubbing his eyes.

    Both parents looked at him questioningly.

    "What's wrong?"

    Li Xihai touched his face and said, "Is there nothing on your face?"

    Father Li's mouth twitched, and Mother Li asked, "Dad, have you sold the stocks?"

    "It's not for sale." Li Xihai said casually.

    Mother Li said: "Today is another daily limit."

    "You are paying attention too."

    Li Xihai smiled and said, so that's what happened.

    It seems normal for parents to pay close attention.

    When I showed them the earnings last night, I naturally focused on which stock I saw.

    "Then what do you think?" Mother Li asked.

    "Don't ask around, I'll make my own decision."

    Father Li said: "Eat!"

    Mother Li didn't say anything, she got up and went to the kitchen.

    The family was chatting and laughing while eating dinner, but they never mentioned the stock market.

    night.

    Li Xihai received another call.

    This time it’s from a junior high school classmate.

    "Xihai, Brother Gang said you are back."

    "Why don't you say anything and don't come out to get together? You're not interesting enough."

    Li Xihai was a little funny, "Okay, Beimen BBQ."

    "Look whoever is there, call out."

    "That's it, I already shouted."

    After hanging up the phone, Li Xihai sent a message to the junior high school brothers and sisters group, and then called Yang Gang.

    "Not tonight, I'm on duty."

    "You drink first."

    "If you want some wine, just ask and I'll ask someone to bring it to you."

    Yang Gang said helplessly.

    "Okay, they should not drink liquor."

    "Okay."

    I hung up the phone and took a look at the WeChat group. There were a lot of messages.

    Yang Gang: "On duty tonight, I will watch you drink and report the battle situation at any time."

    Luo Zhi: "My day, when I go on a business trip, you guys will drink every day."

    Guan Yang: "No, I am also on a business trip. Head of State, you came back at the right time."

    Luo Zhi: "I don't care, anyway, we will make up for this meal when we come back."

    Guan Yang: "It must be replenished."

    Wang Anan: "Haha, let's drink first."

    Xiao Feng: "I'm already in place, where is the head of state?"
title_en: Chapter 6 Father Li: Another daily limit? Son, what kind of vision is this?
